name: Charithra Chandran
bio: Charithra Surya Chandran (born 17 January 1997) is a British actress. She is known for her portrayal as Sabrina Pleasance in the Amazon spy series Alex Rider (2021) and as Edwina Sharma in the Netflix period drama Bridgerton (2022).

credits.title: The Input Problem
credits.overview: A gifted but troubled programmer, on the verge of creating breakthrough technology to restore lost memories, must race to save his Alzheimer's-afflicted father and repair a problematic home life before he loses everything at the hands of his ruthless CEO.

credits.title: Charlie vs. the Chocolate Factory
credits.overview: Years after his famous candy contest, Willy Wonka returns to his factory, where a new wave of "rotten" kids is plotting to nab a priceless chocolate bar.

credits.title: ONE PIECE: Into the Grand Line
credits.overview: The first two episodes of One Piece Season 2: Into the Grand Line screened as a movie in over 200 select theaters in the US, Canada, and Japan on March 10, 2026.

credits.title: Christmas Karma
credits.overview: In contemporary London, miserly British-Indian businessman Eshan Sood is compelled by three ghosts to reflect on his life and to consider the needs of those around him.

credits.title: Together for Palestine
credits.overview: Broadcast of the “Together for Palestine” charity concert, organized by Brian Eno alongside several artists, to raise funds and awareness for Palestinians affected by the ongoing genocide in Gaza perpetrated by Israel.

credits.title: Fight or Flight
credits.overview: A mercenary takes on the job of tracking down a target on a plane but must protect that target when they're surrounded by people trying to kill both of them.

credits.title: How to Date Billy Walsh
credits.overview: Archie has been in love with his best friend Amelia for as long as he can remember. Just when he builds up the courage to declare his feelings, she falls head over heels for Billy Walsh, a new American transfer student.

credits.title: Maya: Birth of a Superhero
credits.overview: A South Asian girl living in modern day London finds her world turned upside down when she gets her first period, sparking her sexual awakening. This pits her against her family's rules. She now faces shame and stigma in her community.

credits.title: Good Intentions
credits.overview: Sef and Rahima are two Londoners from very different cultures. After 5 years, Rahima still hasn't told her father about their relationship but today, she has arranged for them to meet. Their lives are about to be altered forever.

credits.title: Testament: The Parables Retold
credits.overview: Luke hides from the dreaded Temple Guard with the early disciples hoping to further his research into his report on Jesus, but he gets more than he bargained for when he begins to hear the great storyteller's own stories; the parables.

credits.title: Class S
credits.overview: A funny, current and revealing take on the dramatic effects of the new drugs being consumed by university students, but all is not as it appears.

credits.title: Eternals
credits.overview: The Eternals are a team of ancient aliens who have been living on Earth in secret for thousands of years. When an unexpected tragedy forces them out of the shadows, they are forced to reunite against mankind’s most ancient enemy, the Deviants.
